title: Prof. Lemkow: Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom must be at the centre of the process
content:
The draft 'Framework Law', entitled “Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Cohesion” and prepared as part of the “Democratic Society and Peace Process,” was first discussed by the Parliamentary Justice Commission and then by the General Assembly after being submitted to the Speaker of Parliament. The draft was approved in a vote by the General Assembly.


Prof. Louis Lemkow, a sociologist at the University of Barcelona who has been closely following the process, spoke to ANF about the draft framework law. Lemkow said the legislation was an important step but that its scope remained insufficient. Describing the law as “a first step,” he said, “It is a modest step, but nevertheless I think it is important that this law has been passed.”


Lemkow said the law creates a basis for negotiations and provides an opportunity to make progress towards the release of political prisoners. “This law does not cover everything that is needed for peace, but despite that, it is important,” he added.


 


‘Legal and international guarantees must be provided’


Prof. Lemkow emphasized that additional legal and political guarantees would be needed for the peace process to move forward, and said these guarantees could be established with the support of international authorities or with the contribution of a mediation group.


Saying that an international presence would contribute to the process, Lemkow said, “As far as I can see, experience shows that an international presence is always useful. I think international pressure will contribute to the progress of the process. Pressure and an international presence can be very helpful in providing these guarantees and moving forward.”


Regarding the return to Turkey of PKK members and politicians living in exile, Prof. Lemkow said the current situation remained unclear and that it was not yet clear whether the law provided these people with legal protection. He added: “We do not know whether the law that has been passed actually provides such legal protection. We need to see. This is a legal regulation that should provide these guarantees. The fact that it has ultimately passed through parliament is important,” Lemkow said.


‘We would like to see more’


Assessing the scope of the law, Lemkow said it was difficult to understand why it had been limited to 2005. He noted that this limitation could leave some activists and PKK members outside the scope of the law. “In this sense, the scope of the law needs to be expanded,” he said, adding that although the current legislation was insufficient, it could open up new areas for negotiation. “I don’t think this covers everything we want or everything we need to have. Nevertheless, this is a beginning. It is a step towards creating space for negotiation and for moving forward,” he said.


‘Abdullah Öcalan must be free’


Emphasizing that the fact that Önder Apo’s status remains undefined is a major shortcoming, Prof. Lemkow said that “Abdullah Öcalan’s situation is decisive” for the peace process to move forward.


Prof. Lemkow said, “Of course, Öcalan needs to be released. That is clear. It may not happen in the short term, but it is possible.”


Underlining the important role international pressure could play in securing Önder Apo’s freedom, Prof. Lemkow said, “There has already been an international constituency calling for Öcalan’s freedom. This is exactly the time to insist on that.”


Pointing out that peace processes are complex and long-term, Lemkow referred to the examples of South Africa and Ireland. Despite the difficulties encountered in those processes, he said progress had been achieved. “We were able to release political prisoners and really achieve a sustainable peace; we were able to create this space for genuine peace and tranquility,” he said.


‘The rights of the Kurdish people must be legally guaranteed’


Lemkow agreed with criticism that the law does not sufficiently guarantee the rights of the Kurdish people, and added that for lasting peace, it was necessary not only to address the situation of political prisoners but also to legally guarantee the fundamental rights of the Kurdish people.


Lemkow particularly highlighted the right to education in one’s mother tongue. “What is certain is that this is not the law we were expecting. We wanted something stronger that included these guarantees. Laws must be passed that guarantee the Kurdish people the right to receive education in their mother tongue, that is, in …

author: Unknown
title: Yılmaz: 'Framework Law' is important, but it will not solve the Kurdish question on its own
content:
The 'Framework Law' expected as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process was adopted by the General Assembly of Parliament with 468 votes. For the 12-article legislation to enter into force, the National Security Council (MGK) must determine and confirm that all organizations affiliated with the PKK/KCK have dissolved themselves and that arms have been completely laid down. If this condition is met, the legislation provides for the postponement of investigations, prosecutions and finalized convictions in relation to the offences covered by the proposal. The legislation excludes from its scope people who received aggravated life sentences before 2005 or who were convicted of offences carrying an aggravated life sentence.


Ercan Yılmaz, chair of the Amed branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD), spoke to ANF about the 'Framework Law' adopted by Parliament. He said: “Many people who have spoken out on the Kurdish issue, expressed their views and made democratic demands have faced investigations and prosecutions because of anti-democratic provisions in Turkish legislation. So we regard this as an important initiative and stage in resolving the Kurdish question.


Because until now, everyone who has spoken out, taken action or made demands concerning the resolution of the Kurdish issue has faced considerable judicial pressure because of the adverse laws in Turkish legislation. As you know, particularly after 2015, following the end of the 2013–2015 period and the ongoing peace process, there was an attempted coup. A state of emergency was declared after the coup attempt, and many pieces of legislation, including already problematic laws such as the Turkish Penal Code and the Execution of Sentences Law, were made even more restrictive and turned into instruments of repression against opponents. Those who were generally subjected to the harshest sanctions were people who expressed their views and opinions on the Kurdish question.”


The way must be opened for participation in social life


Yılmaz said legal reforms were important in addressing the situation that had emerged during four decades of conflict, and stressed that the way must be opened for democratic politics and public debate. Pointing out that the framework law was also an important step towards enabling prisoners to return to social life and citizens who had been forced to leave the country to return to Turkey, Yılmaz continued: “Today, in terms of partially addressing the situation that emerged during these forty years of conflict, it is an important stage to eliminate the punishments imposed under these legal provisions, particularly in order to open the way for the issue to be discussed through democratic means.


Despite its many shortcomings, we believe this is an important legal change in terms of enabling people to participate more freely in social life in the next phase of the process, allowing citizens who were forced to leave the country to return, and enabling citizens who cannot return to Turkey because of accusations or convictions of PKK membership to participate in social and political life. Of course, this legislation alone is not sufficient to resolve the Kurdish question.”


Some issues becoming taboos is a cause for concern


Yılmaz recalled that human rights defenders and lawyers had submitted numerous proposals during the preparation of the law. He said: “Since the framework law was first discussed as a legislative proposal, many sectors, human rights defenders and lawyers have repeatedly expressed their views on the issue. We, too, expressed our views as the Human Rights Association. We should say that seeing some of these views reflected in the legislative proposal gives us satisfaction and hope in terms of resolving the Kurdish question. But the fact that some issues are still treated as taboos and remain outside the scope of this law will cause the process to take somewhat longer.”


Not a single citizen should continue to face judicial pressure


Emphasizing that the struggle must continue following the adoption of the law in its current form, Yılmaz said the legislation represented an important stage but that those excluded from its scope must also remain on the agenda. He said: “According to figures reported in the media, the release of approximately 4,000 prisoners, the return of approximately 2,000 PKK militants to Turkey, and the return of thousands of citizens who were forced to seek refuge in different countries …

author: collection
title: DDR-Reise-1986
content:
Der folgende Film ist die digitalisierte Fassung einer analogen Audiovision, die ich 1986 nach einer Jugendgruppen-Reise in die DDR zusammen mit meinem Freund Martin Buchholz erstellt habe. Wir besuchten Stralsund, Rostock und die Insel Rügen. Die AV-Show erzählt nicht vorrangig eine (Reise-)Geschichte, sondern ist eher impressionistisch angelegt. Aber die wechselnden Eindrücke bilden dann doch die ständige kognitive Dissonanz ab, der wir uns während dieser einen Woche ausgesetzt sahen. Besonders beispielhaft sind hier die Aufnahmen aus der zum Meeresmuseum umgewidmeten Stralsunder Katharinenkirche.


Die ursprüngliche Präsentation ist komplett analog entstanden: Fotos aufgenommen mit Olympus OM-Spiegelreflexkameras auf Kodak ED200 (5076) Farbdiafilm, alle einzeln in Glasdiarahmen montiert. Für die Überblendprojektion kamen zwei Kodak Carousel 2000 S-AV Projektoren zum Einsatz, betrieben von einem Electrosonic ES62 Steuergerät. Die Tonmischung fand auf einem Tascam 4-Spur-Cassettendeck statt, die Musikzuspielung erfolgte von Vinyl-LP. Da die Tascam die Tonspuren nicht sauber trennte, ist in leisen Musikpassagen manchmal der Steuerton mitzuhören. Eine digitale  Nachbearbeitung mit Adobe Audition konnte dies nicht komplett beseitigen.


Die Dias wurden mit einer aktuellen spiegellosen Canon R6 mit 20 MP digitalisiert. Bei der Bildbearbeitung stand eine möglichst originalgetreue Wiedergabe im Vordergrund. Nur starke Unterbelichtung und Farbstiche durch das Alter des Materials wurden etwas ausgeglichen, sowie Kratzer und Flecken entfernt.


Die zu hörenden Musikstücke sind:


Gustav Mahler, Symphonie Nr. V, 4. Satz


Gustav Mahler, Symphonie Nr. VI, 1. Satz


Johann Sebastian Bach, »Dorische« Toccata und Fuge


Edvard Grieg, In der Halle des Bergkönigs (aus den Peer Gynt Suiten)


Gustav Mahler, Symphonie Nr. VI, 4. Satz (Finale)


Bedenkt man, dass sowohl die Originaldias als auch die Ton-Cassette satte 40 Jahre alt sind, ist die Qualität noch erstaunlich gut. Auch der auf Computer-Endlospapier handgeschriebene Mischplan ist noch erhalten. Ob die digitalen Geräte und Daten jemals so eine Lebensdauer erreichen werden, ist nicht sicher. Die digitalen Kameras der ersten Generationen nutzten Speicher, für die es heute kaum noch Laufwerke gibt (zB. Sony Mavica mit 3,5” Disketten). Die damalige Bildqualität war nach heutigen Maßstäben katastrophal. CD/DVD-Laufwerke, die zur Jahrtausendwende noch massenhaft zur Archivierung  verwendet wurden, sind heute in keinem modernen Computer mehr verbaut. Dateiformate und Betriebssysteme ändern sich, viele der modernen Kameras nutzen proprietäre RAW-Formate, die möglicherweise in wenigen Jahren von dann weiterentwickelten  Programmen nicht mehr lesbar sind. Wie überhaupt Digitalfotos ohne ein entsprechendes Lesegerät einfach nichts wert sind, während man ein analoges Dia, Negativ oder Papierbild »einfach so« betrachten kann.

author: Unknown
title: 17 августа - День рождения политзаключённого Никиты Уварова
content:
Поздравьте Никиту с днём рождения!

Как пишет группа поддержки в канале «Дело канских подростков»:

17 августа Никите Уварову исполнится 21 год. Даже не верится, ведь когда мы начинали кампанию в поддержку Никиты и других фигурантов «дела канских подростков», ему было 15 лет, а в момент задержания и вовсе 14. В 2022 году суд приговорил Никиту к 5 годам заключения, он должен был выйти в 20 лет. Но вот Никите уже 21, а он всё ещё сидит. Как так получилось?

Летом 2020 года в городе Канск Красноярского края Никита Уваров с друзьями, разделявшими анархистские идеалы, расклеивали листовки в поддержку политзаключённых и с критикой государства. Одну из листовок наклеили на здание местного отдела ФСБ.

Через некоторое время подростков задержали. Силовики давили на молодых людей и их родителей, заставили разблокировать телефоны, а позже на основании найденных в них переписок и полученных под давлением показаний Дениса Михайленко и Богдана Андреева сфабриковали дело об «обучении терроризму» — якобы подростки готовились взорвать здание ФСБ в Канске.

10 февраля 2022 года Никиту приговорили к 5 годам, а Михайленко и Андрееву дали условные сроки. К тому моменту Никита уже провел почти год с в СИЗО и должен был освободиться весной 2026 года.

За месяц до освобождения против Никиты сфабриковали новое дело, обвинив его в участии в признанном экстремистским «движении «АУЕ». Следствие утверждает, что в колонии Никита якобы распространял среди других заключённых «законы криминального мира». При этом ИК-31, где он отбывал срок, — режимная, или «красная», колония, в которой тюремная субкультура существует только в том объёме, в котором выгодна администрации.

Особенно показательно, что дело возбудили по материалам красноярского УФСБ буквально перед самым окончанием Никитиного срока. В феврале Никиту перевели в СИЗО-1 Красноярска, а затем суд заключил его под стражу уже по новому обвинению. Поэтому 19 марта, когда Никита должен был выйти на свободу, этого не произошло.

7 августа Советский районный суд Красноярска в очередной раз удовлетворил ходатайство следствия и продлили содержание Никиты в СИЗО ещё на 2 месяца — до 11 октября.

Также стало известно, что Никиту перевели в одиночную камеру по ходатайству защиты. В 12-местной камере Никита опасался разговаривать с сокамерниками, которые активно интересовались происходящим в колонии, так как подобные разговоры тоже могли подшить в дело в качестве доказательств «распространения криминальной субкультуры».

По новому делу Никите грозит ещё от 2 до 6 лет заключения. Свой 21-й день рождения Никита снова встретит за решёткой — поэтому мы очень просим вас поздравить его и напомнить, что все эти годы о нём помнят и ждут его на свободе.

День рождения Никиты уже совсем скоро, поэтому рекомендуем воспользоваться электронными сервисами для отправки писем. Возможна отправка из-за рубежа и отплата зарубежной картой.

Доступные в СИЗО-1 Красноярска сервисы: «Ф-письмо» (оплата российской картой), «Зонателеком» (возможна оплата как российской, так и зарубежной картой), PrisonMail.Online (только для зарубежных карт).

Данные для отправки: Красноярский край (Krasnoyarsk region), СИЗО-1 Красноярск (SIZO-1 Krasnoyarsk), Уваров Никита Андреевич 2005 г. р.

Почтовый адрес: 660075, г. Красноярск, ул. Республики, 72, СИЗО-1

Пока не свободны все, не свободен никто!

author: Unknown
title: Prisoners’ relatives: All political prisoners must be released
content:
The 'Framework Law' prepared as part of a democratic solution to the Kurdish question and containing provisions concerning detainees and convicted prisoners, was approved by the General Assembly of Parliament. In Amed, relatives of prisoners commented on the legislation.


The families stressed that the legislation was important in terms of placing the process on a legal footing, but emphasized that the steps to be taken, and the decisions adopted needed to be inclusive.


 


'Two of my sons will be released, but I'm not happy'


While lawyers described the legislation as a “first step” and said its scope should be expanded, relatives of prisoners called for all political prisoners to be released and the prisons emptied.


Tekyeddin Sürme, whose two sons are imprisoned, said that although the legislation creates the possibility of release for some prisoners, it did not make them fully happy. “Yes, a law has been passed, but it is not the law we expected after two years. The state prepared the provisions according to its own interests. I have two sons who are imprisoned, and both of them fall within the scope of this legislation. But since the other prisoners will not be released, this does not make us very happy. We want all the prisoners, first and foremost our Leader, to be outside,” Sürme said.


All prisoners should be released


Sürme said that those released from prison should live together with society and that a similar approach should be adopted for those returning from exile. He said: “Our friends who will return from exile also need to come back here and live among the people, together with them. Freedom becomes a reality by living among the people and working together with them. First and foremost, we want a law to be passed for our Leader, and then for all our friends. The laws that are passed from now on should be more inclusive. This step must be followed by further steps, and all the prisons should be emptied. That is our greatest demand.”


Obstacles to democratic politics must be removed


Yusuf Erdoğan, a member of the Prison Commission of the Amed branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD), said that they had previously shared their views on the legislation with the public. He said: “We consider this law, particularly in terms of resolving the Kurdish question, to be a ‘first-step law.’ Of course, it has shortcomings. However, we believe these shortcomings must be addressed in the legislation that follows. Despite everything, we consider this legal step that has been taken to be valuable.” 


Erdoğan said the legislation should be regarded as a starting point for resolving the problems and noted that it contained provisions contrary to the principle of equality guaranteed under Article 10 of the Constitution. He said: “For example, it is clear that the bill contains many provisions that are contrary to Article 10 of the Constitution, namely the principle of equality. Legal obstacles must also be removed regarding the right to engage in politics and the participation in democratic politics of prisoners released from prison. We have repeatedly stated that the obstacles preventing prisoners released from prison, as well as returning PKK militants, from participating in democratic politics must be removed as part of the aim of resolving the Kurdish question through democratic means.”


Nurcan Yalçın also assessed the framework law both as a relative of a prisoner and as a journalist. While noting that the legislation had shortcomings, Yalçın said it was important that many political prisoners currently in prison would be released. She added that “the fact that Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan and those who received aggravated life sentences before 2005 were excluded from the scope of the legislation has caused disappointment in society.”


The law must be expanded


Nurcan Yalçın said that statements had indicated that the legislation could be expanded in the coming period and therefore argued that, despite its shortcomings, the law should be regarded as a positive step. She said: “The framework law is now being regarded as the first concrete and positive step taken by the state within the framework of the Peace and Democratic Society Process. However, it is of course our hope that this law will be expanded further and that the other prisoners, as well as Kurdish People’s Leader Mr Abdullah Öcalan, will be included in its scope and attain their status and freedom.”

author: Unknown
title: Guerrilla Baran: 15 August Offensive is the resurrection of the Kurdish people
content:
The launch of the 15 August Offensive in Kurdistan under the leadership of the great commander Egîd (Mahsum Korkmaz), and the beginning of armed warfare, represented a major resurrection for the Kurdish people. The offensive demonstrated that the Kurdish people were no longer without means or without anyone to defend them. Commander Egîd opened a new path for the Kurdish people to defend their existence and, in this respect, became a symbol of guerrilla warfare in Kurdistan.


YJA Star guerrilla Rehşan Baran spoke about the 42nd anniversary of the 15 August Offensive. YJA Star guerrilla Rehşan Baran said: "With the launch of the 15 August Offensive, we have achieved very significant gains. Whatever is said today about the 15 August Offensive, it will never be enough. Because it is thanks to this offensive that we have reached where we are today. The developments that emerged around Comrade Egîd had an impact on young people and the population, leading to strong participation in the ranks of the guerrillas. At that time, the Kurdish people were indeed under tremendous pressure and attack. However, thanks to the movement created by Leader Apo and the 15 August Offensive carried out by Commander Egîd, major steps were taken for the freedom of the Kurdish people. With the 15 August Offensive, our people understood that they too had a force capable of defending themselves."


 


Guerrilla Baran added: "As the Kurdish people, we were finally able to begin speaking of our existence. Comrade Egîd brought this consciousness to the Kurdish people. Comrade Egîd was loved among the Kurdish people for his Apoist personality. What was Comrade Egîd’s purpose and goal? What kind of personality had he built himself into? In short, the important thing is how we will enhance the value that Commander Egîd left us and how we will uphold it. Our people must now realise that there are no obstacles standing before them.


We must understand the meaning and importance of this day; we must know what 15 August means to us. Because this offensive established the existence of the Kurds. We will fulfil Comrade Egîd’s aim in this offensive through our struggle. We have reached where we are today thanks to Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan]. We must intensify our struggle and take major steps in terms of self-defence. On this occasion, once again, I wish Leader Apo, our people and all our comrades a happy 15 August."

author: Unknown
title: The games being played over Shengal and the resistance of the Yazidi community
content:
On the 12th anniversary of the genocide, as the date 3 August 2026 approached, the suffering endured by the Yazidi community and by all people of conscience is the result of multifaceted political and geopolitical balances. The massacres that began with the attacks by ISIS in August 2014 cannot be explained solely by the brutality of a radical organisation; they were part of a broader genocidal project aimed at changing the region’s demographic and political map.


Twelve years later, Shengal is not only a place where suffering and disasters are commemorated, but has also become a center of conflict and strategic calculations among regional and international powers. The massacre, which took place before the eyes of the entire world, demonstrated the depth of the Yazidi people’s exclusion from legal protection and their vulnerability. The current situation in Shengal has also revealed the true face of autonomous diplomacy, politics aimed at defending interests, and international indifference.


This process shows that the Shengal issue has now gone beyond the limits of a humanitarian disaster and has become a political, legal and sovereignty crisis directly linked to the future of state structures in the Middle East.


Theatrical diplomacy, empty promises and bureaucratic corruption


In the period following the liberation of Shengal, there were numerous conferences, statements full of promises and theatrical diplomacy. Under public pressure, the international community and multinational institutions made sweeping promises to rebuild Shengal, recognise the genocide at the highest legal levels and bring the perpetrators before international courts.


Yet over the past 12 years, it has become clear that these promises have not been fulfilled, disappearing into bureaucratic labyrinths and networks of geopolitical interests. Funds allocated to Shengal did not reach the territory of Shengal and were siphoned off under the influence of organised corruption within Iraq’s administrative systems.


One of the most critical issues in Shengal politics was the Shengal Agreement of 9 October 2020, signed between the Iraqi central government and the Kurdistan Regional Government under the supervision of the United Nations and the Turkish state. This agreement was one of the clearest examples of top-down politics and the disregard for the will of the people. Decisions concerning the region’s future were taken without the participation of Yazidi local councils or genuine representatives of the forces that defended Shengal during its darkest days.


The main purpose of this agreement was not to resolve infrastructure problems or ensure the security of the population, but to attempt to restore the political and military hegemony of the forces that had withdrawn in 2014. Rather than bring peace, the agreement failed to take into account the reality on the ground and the autonomous will of the Yazidi community, deepening political and military tensions in the region and raising questions about the credibility of international efforts.


The use of refugee camps as a political tool 


From a humanitarian and social perspective, the most devastating consequence of this policy of siege is the situation of the hundreds of thousands of Yazidi refugees who, 12 years later, are still living in plastic tents. Life in the camps in Duhok province is no longer a temporary situation, but has become a political tool and an instrument of demographic change. The failure of these families to return to their ancestral lands is not a personal choice or simply the result of a lack of opportunities; it is the outcome of an organised policy of obstruction.


The authorities are preventing people from making their legitimate return through checkpoints, administrative obstacles, psychological warfare and fear propaganda. The aim of this policy of obstruction is to keep the Yazidi population in the camps as a tool of electoral pressure while simultaneously creating a demographic vacuum in Shengal, thereby facilitating the implementation of long-term hegemonic projects in the region.


Looking at the situation inside Shengal and its villages, the reality of this policy of despair becomes even clearer. Areas such as Sîba Şêx Xidir, Til Izêr, Herdan, Girzerik and Koço have been turned into physically and economically dead towns. The city’s infrastructure, clean water network, electricity system and health centers have deteriorated to a level that makes normal …

title: "Di mijara aşitiyê de bi tu awayî zarok wekî aktorekê nehatin nirxandin"
content:
Em weke Weqfa Ragihandinê ya IPSê/bianet, ji Tîrmeha 2023an vir ve bi armanca civaka sivîl bi hêz bike û rêyên têkiliyê bi awayekî birêkûpêk zêde bikin, bi Rêxistinên Mafan re rêze-civînan pêk tînin. Me civîna xwe ya 36an bi Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok re pêk anî.


Me civîn di 12ê Tebaxê de bi awayê online li dar xist. Li ser navê Weqfa Ragihandinê ya IPSê/bianetê Koordînatora Atolye BİAyê Ceyda Sungur, Koordînatora Lêkolînan a Atolye BİAyê Sinem Aydınlı, Rêvebirê Karên Nivîsaran ê berpirsyar ê bianetê Vecîh Cuzdan û Nûçegihana Hevkaran a Civaka Sivîl a bianetê/Asîstana Atolye BİAyê Evrim Gunduz beşdarî civînê bûn. Her weja li ser navê Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok jî Hivran Timur û Zeynep Sidar Irmak di civînê de amade bûn.


"Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok"ê projeyeke nû ji bo mafên zarokan daye destpêkirin


10 Mijdar 2022


Di civînê de, em li ser xebatên çand-huner û piştevaniya psîkososyal ên ku Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok bi zarokan re birêve dibin, atolyeyên wan ên ji bo zimanê dayikê û xebatên wan ên li taxên navçeya Sur a Amedê axivîn.


Hîvran Tîmûr: Piştî tayînkirina qeyuman komeleya me weke pêdiviyeke ava bû


Hîvran Tîmûrê diyar kir ku li Amedê di sala 2017an de piştî tayînkirina qeyuman ji bo şaredariyan û girtina hin saziyan, li bajêr pêdiviyek çêbû. Komeleya Berî Her Tiştî Zarok di encama van pêdiviyan de ava bû.


Piranîya xebatên komeleyê ji çalakiyên çand-hunerê pêk tên. Tîmûrê ku destnîşan kir ku ew xebatên xwe bi şêwezarên kurdî, kurmancî û kirmanckî/zazakî dimeşînin û piştevaniya psîkososyal jî beşeke ji çalakiyên wan e.


“Li Semsûrê zarok hîna jî nikarin mafên xwe bi kar bînin”


16 Cotmeh 2023


Tîmûrê aşkere kir ku piştî erdhejên 6ê Sibata 2023an wan li Semsûrê jî dest bi xebatan kir û diyar kir ku di van demên dawî de wan dîsa giranî daye ser Amedê. Tîmûrê destnîşan kir ku xebatên li Sûrê jî bi demê re ber bi rêxistinbûna taxê ve berfireh bûne û got:


“Dema em li Sûrê bicih bûn, me dît ku hewcedariyên cuda hene. Me dît ku zarokên li vir him ji komên olî yên tûndrew bandor bûne, him jî li gel malbatên xwe piştî şerên bajarî ên sala 2015an travmayên giran jiyane. Vê yekê pirsiyara ‘di warê rêxistinbûna taxê de em dikarin çi bikin?’ bi me re çêkir. Niha atolyeyên me hene ku em bêyî tu projeyan, bi awayekî xwebexş birêve dibin.”


Zeynep Sîdar Irmak: Em hewl didin bi zarokan re tîmeke şanoyê ava bikin


Zeynep Sîdar Irmakê da zanîn ku piştî wan komele bar kir Sûrê, wan di heyama havînê de dest bi xebateke pîlot kir. Irmakê destnîşan kir ku armanca wan dîtina hewcedariyên zarokên taxê û baldariya wan a li ser atolyeyan bû. Her weha Sîdar Irmakê ragihand ku bi pêşengiya dilxwazan çar atolye hatin vekirin, malbatan rasterast serî li van atolyeyan dan û atolyeyan du mehan berdewam kirin.


Irmakê got ku wan xwestiye piştî heyama havînê jî xebatên xwe bidomînin. Ji bo vê yekê jî diyar kir ku wan ji zarokên beşdarî atolyeyan bûne komek ava kiriye:


“Me ji zarokên ku beşdarî atolyeyan bûbûn komeke ji heft kesî pêk tê ava kir. Em bi malbatan re axivîn. Heke malbat jî bipejirîne ango em destûrê ji malbatan bigirin, em dixwazin di heyama dibistanê de jî bi vê komê re perwerdeyên drama, kûkla û kurdî bidomînin û ji wan tîmeke şanoyê ava bikin.”


Irmak: Armanca me ew e ku em vê xebatê li navçeyên cuda jî bikin


Zeynep Sîdar Irmakê behsa wê yekê kir ku komele li navçeya Çinara Amedê li dijî zewacên di temenê piçûkî de û zewacên bi darêzorê xebatan dimeşîne. Irmakê got ku xebata li Çinarê ji bendewariyên wan zêdetir bi pêş ketiye. Komele plan dike ku di heyama nû de xebatên weke vê li Bismil û Farqînê jî bike.


Irmakê destnîşan kir ku ew ê di heyama nû de çarçoveya atolyeyan jî berfirehtir bikin:


“Em ê perwerdeyên wekheviya zayendî ya civakî, tenduristiya zêdebûnê û tenduristiya zayendî jî li atolyeyên xwe zêde bikin. Me atolyeyên li Çinarê wekî du perwerdeyên cuda yên ji bo mêran û ciwanên nûgîhaştî plan kiribûn. Em ê xebatên nû jî bi veqetandina koman û berfirehkirina van sernavan bi rêve bibin.”


Tîmûr: Di mijara aşitiyê de bi tu awayî zarok wekî aktorekê nehatin nirxandin


Hîvran Timûrê got ku komeleyê mijara aşitiyê jî girtiye rojeva xebatên xwe û destnîşan kir ku di nîqaşên ku tên kirin de serpêhatî û gotinên zarokan bi têra xwe cih nagirin.


Tîmûrê da zanîn ku wan berê bi zarokan re xebatên wênegiriyê meşandine û ji ber vê ezmûnê jî wan dest bi fikirînê kiriye ku ka rojnamegeriyeke aştîxwaz ya zarokparêz dikare çawa bê avakirin. Tîmûr weha pê çû:

title: Des surveillants de Moulins-Yzeure incitent au suicide
content:
Alors qu'il entame sa quinzième année de prison, Mickaël Gilgenmann continue à subir l'acharnement de l'administration pénitentiaire (

AP

) et des surveillants de la prison de Moulins-Yzeure. Après de nombreuses années en prison, et alors qu'il est aménageable depuis plus de cinq ans, aucune perspective de sortie n'est envisageable, tant que Mickaël reste enfermé en maison centrale plutôt qu'en centre de détention (prison aux mesures moins sécuritaires) et inscrit au répertoire des détenus particulièrement signalés (

DPS

).


Dans la nuit du 3 au 4 août 2026, notre ami Mickaël a fait une tentative de suicide quelques heures après qu'un des surveillants de Moulins-Yzeure lui a dit : «

 

vas-y fous toi en l'air, t'as plus que ça comme solution

 

».


Mickaël n'est pas suicidaire et n'a pas envie de mourir. Les maltraitances et la violence qu'il subit au sein de la prison de Moulins-Yzeure l'ont amené à s'ouvrir les bras, le ventre et à faire une tentative de suicide. Il n'avait jamais attenté à sa vie jusqu'ici.


La direction et les surveillants de Moulins-Yzeure lui refusent des soins décents en l'abandonnant dans sa cellule alors qu'il est blessé, ou en le recousant sans anesthésie.


Ils l'empêchent de prendre des douches et d'aller en promenade.


Ils l'isolent en coupant de façon intempestive ses appels sur la cabine.


Ils l'infantilisent et le menottent à chaque mouvement.


Ils l'humilient avec des propos racistes à l'encontre des Voyageurs.


Ils lui refusent un transfert vers un centre de détention.


Ils n'ont jamais demandé sa désinscription au registre des

DPS

, contrairement à ce qu'ils promettent depuis un an.


Ils utilisent des motifs bidons tels qu'un dessin d'hélicoptère dans l'un de ses courriers pour prolonger de telles mesures.


Ils donnent des coups de pied dans la porte de sa cellule pour l'empêcher de dormir la nuit.


Ils ne lui délivrent pas les médicaments qui lui sont pourtant prescrits par ordonnance.


Ils ne prennent aucun rendez-vous médical pour la pose de ses prothèses auditives, malgré une prescription médicale hospitalière urgente en ce sens.


Ils veulent le laisser devenir sourd, alors que c'est le coup de pied d'un maton dans son tympan qui a provoqué sa surdité.


Ils lui nient sa dignité.


Et suite à tout ça, il a failli mourir.


Nous tenons et tiendrons entièrement responsable la prison Moulins-Yzeure de toute éventuelle atteinte à la santé et à l'intégrité physique et mentale de Mickaël.


Mickaël Gilgenmann exige :


 la fin de toutes les brimades et humiliations que les surveillants de la prison de Moulins-Yzeure lui font subir, ainsi qu'aux autres prisonniers

 

;

 que la direction de la prison de Moulins-Yzeure et l'administration pénitentiaire respectent leurs engagements

 

;

 la levée de son statut

DPS

 

;

 son transfert vers un centre de détention.


Des proches de Mickaël Gilgenmann


P.-S. : Nous invitons toute personne à manifester son soutien auprès de Mickaël en envoyant un courrier à la direction de l'administration pénitentiaire. Ci-dessous leur adresse et, si besoin, un modèle de lettre à leur faire parvenir.


Direction de l'administration pénitentiaire


13, place Vendôme


75042 Paris Cedex 1


Objet : Alerter de toute urgence sur le risque vital encouru par M. Mickaël Gilgenmann


Madame, Monsieur,


Je vous écris car, en tant que proche ami de M. Mickaël Gilgenmann, je suis aujourd'hui particulièrement préoccupé par sa situation. Il est actuellement incarcéré à la prison de Moulins-Yzeure.


M. Gilgenmann est incarcéré depuis 2012. Sa date de sortie est fixée à janvier 2032. Il entre dans sa quinzième année d'emprisonnement et, bien qu'il n'ait jamais été condamné par une cour d'assises, aucune réelle perspective de réinsertion ne lui a jamais été proposée. Cela fait plus de cinq ans qu'il pourrait en principe bénéficier d'un aménagement de peine.


Pourtant, il y a un an, la direction du Centre pénitentiaire de Moulins-Yzeure s'était formellement engagée auprès de M. Gilgenmann à envisager son transfert vers un centre de détention et sa désinscription du répertoire des détenus particulièrement signalés (

DPS

; or vous n'êtes pas sans savoir que le statut

DPS

 et le maintien en maison centrale plutôt qu'en centre de détention ne peuvent que peser très défavorablement sur le parcours d'exécution de peine d'un prisonnier et sur ses démarches de réinsertion. M. Gilgenmann a …

author: By L. Cam Anderson, Contributor
title: The Fight Against Google’s Minnesota Data Centers
content:
Mankato, MN — Minnesotans gathered on July 25 in the basement of Mankato’s Grace Lutheran Church for a panel on the hyperscale data centers seemingly popping up across the North Star State.


Roughly 80 attendees from the Mankato area and further filled the underground room, frequently adjusting themselves on metal folding chairs throughout the three hour event as the whirring air conditioner kept the space nearly refrigerated.


Aubree Derkson of Pine Island, who has been heavily involved in the fight against the planned Google data center in her small, rural community of roughly 3,000, was the event’s first speaker. Pine Island is 20 minutes north of Rochester on U.S. Highway Route 52 in southern Minnesota.


Derkson described the work that goes into investigating data center development, a seemingly monumental task when the local government signs non-disclosure agreements, otherwise known as NDAs, with the companies that own and develop them. As a result of such agreements, she has to use roundabout methods to root out project details, including calling utility companies to ask about

new high voltage power lines

 and submitting multiple data requests with different government authorities to build a picture of what’s happening.


“Learn from us,” Derkson said. “Because this is not fun.”


The event, cloistered underground, appeared to drip with a paranoia familiar to conspiracy theorists scanning the horizon for black helicopters through shuttered windows. In this case, however, the conspiracy is not imagined. In both

Pine Island

 and

Hermantown

, the projects were kept secret by all parties involved until they were announced in the Star Tribune

following months of lobbying by Google in the state legislature for favorable conditions

 before any plans were announced.


Beyond hiding entire projects from the community until they are well underway through NDAs, Google and other companies erecting hyperscale data centers across the state and the rest of the country consistently obfuscate environmental impacts and the real effects these facilities have on communities. Hyperscale sites are massive structures housing thousands of servers for cloud computing and generative AI, exceeding 10,000 square feet.


Underscoring the cloak-and-dagger nature of these developments, each was given a codename in advance of Google claiming ownership: Project Loon in Hermantown and Project Skyway in Pine Island.


Smaller data centers, such as the dozen already spread around the Twin Cities, typically have an energy capacity less than 20 megawatts. Hyperscale data centers planned for the state have capacities well above 100 megawatts, with the largest being 400 megawatts with

the

panned Geronimo Power data center the was planned for Nobles County.

 


For scale, 100 megawatts is enough electricity for 100,000 households,

according to the International Energy Agency

.


Notably, Google has not yet revealed the expected power consumption of Project Loon or Protect Skyway. However, the plan for Project Loon includes the generation of 700 megawatts, according to a

presentation delivered by Google

 in May.


“While data centers are hardly new, hyperscale ones are in a different league,” the Minnesota Center for Environmental Advocacy (MCEA) said in

a June statement regarding a recent court victory against a data center in Faribault

. “They are AI-driven industrial campuses that can consume millions of gallons of water a day for cooling, draw enormous amounts of electricity, generate significant noise and light pollution, and, if enough are built, put serious strain on our state’s already stressed groundwater supply and clean energy goals.”


The opaqueness of these operations when dealing with the public is not due to a lack of knowledge. Rather than figuring such things out on the fly, these things are planned well in advance.


 “They know exactly what’s being built,” Bryan Schneider said during his portion of the presentation. Schneider, who was one of the event’s six speakers, has managed data centers in the past and currently works at the Minnesota State University, Mankato, data center.


“They know every floor tile, every ceiling tile, every light that’s going to be in there. […] They know everything. But if you don’t know about it, it’s being withheld.”


 Bryan Schneider


Related:

Data Centers, the Climate Crisis, and Community Defense

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 14 août
content:
Ce que l'on peut dire de l'éphéméride des luttes du 14 août, c'est qu'elle est particulièrement chargée. Alors que cette charge historique résonne dans les luttes que nous avons à mener aujourd'hui et dans celles que nous aurons à mener demain.


1791 :

 A Saint-Domingue, la révolte des esclaves débute, ce qui mènera à l'indépendance de Haïti 12 ans plus tard.


1843 :

 En Floride, la révolte des indien-ne-s Séminoles est écrasée par le gouvernorat après plus de sept ans de résistance.


1846 :

 Aux Etats-Unis, Henry-David Thoreau, auteur anarchiste, est incarcéré pour son refus de s'acquitter de ses impôts. Celui-ci refusait de financer l'Etat qui exploite et opprime grâce à l'argent collecté par ces taxes.


1850 :

 En Californie, début d'une émeute liée à l'occupation des terres.


1878 :

 A Benevento en Italie, ouverture du procès des internationalistes (Malatesta, Cafiero, etc.) pour "

le délit de conspiration dans le but de changer et de détruire la forme de gouvernement, d'inciter les habitants à s'armer contre le pouvoir de l'Etat, de provoquer la guerre civile (...), d'attentat en bande armée, et de complicité dans les délits de : blessures volontaires par arme à feu sur la personne des carabiniers du roi ...

". Ils seront tous acquittés.


1903 :

 A Genève, parution du premier numéro de "Khleb i Volia" (Pain et Liberté), journal anarchiste en langue russe.


1908 :

 A Springfield dans l'Illinois, des émeutes éclatent entre la communauté Noire et la police. Finalement, l'armée devra intervenir. Cet événement sera celui qui déclenchera le processus de création de la NAACP.


1962 :

 Dans le Massachussets, deux hommes armés braquent un fourgon de la poste et repartent avec un butin de 1.5 millions de dollars.


1968 :

 A Capetown en Afrique du Sud, des étudiant-e-s contre l'apartheid occupent l'université.


1969 :

 A Belfast, en Irlande du Nord, le bilan est de dix civils tués lors de la répression d'une émeute de trois jours connue sous le nom de bataille du Bogside. Les troupes anglaises sont déployées en nombre dans tout le pays.


1971 :

 A Belfast, un soldat de l'armée britannique est tué par l'IRA 'Officielle' (OIRA).


1972 :

 - A Toulouse, rue de l'esquille dans la nuit, vol dans une imprimerie de matériel qui servira à imprimer les publications du MIL (Mouvement Ibérique de Libération).


 A Belfast, deux soldats de l'armée d'Angleterre sont tués par une bombe de l'IRA.


1974 :

 A Lourdes, fausse alerte à la bombe revendiquée par les Groupes d'Action Révolutionnaire Internationaliste (GARI).


1979 :

 En Espagne, la police découvre et abat Pedro Tabanera Pérez, l'un des membres les plus activement recherchés du groupe armé des GRAPO (Groupe de Résistance Antifasciste du Premier Octobre).


1980 :

 A Gdansk en Pologne, les 17.000 ouvriers des chantiers navals Lénine se mettent en grève générale, après plus de deux mois d'agitation.


1983 :

 Sur un ferry au départ du Havre, les forces de sécurité françaises découvrent un stock d'armes, qui devait selon eux être livrées à l'IRA lors de l'arrivée au port de Rosslare en Irlande.


1994 :

 Ilich Ramírez Sánchez, aussi dit Carlos (pas celui qui chante Papayou, celui qui faisait de la lutte armée), est capturé.


1998 :

 En Argentine, sous la présidence de Carlos Menem, les juges décident de suspendre les enquêtes dirigées contre les anciens dignitaires de la dictature militaire. Ces enquêtes rouvriront dans les années 2000 sous Kirchner.


Voir

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 14 août.

author: Brian Hioe
title: KMT Hits Out At Internet Disruption Drill as “Martial Law”
content:
THE KMT HAS hit out at an Internet slowdown drill, which was conducted during the annual Wan-an drill yesterday. The Wan-an drill is an annual air raid drill in which individuals are called on to shelter in place. This year was the first time that mobile Internet was slowed down, so as to prepare for potential contingencies involving disruptions to Taiwan’s communication networks.

Taiwan is increasingly wary of what might take place if its submarine cables, connecting Taiwan to the rest of the world in terms of Internet, were cut in wartime by Chinese vessels. When this occurred to Taiwan’s outlying island of Matsu in 2023, sending a text message would take 20 minutes. Likewise, China has stepped up grey-zone activity that could potentially allow for the cutting of submarine cables.

Nevertheless, it may not be a surprise that at a time when the KMT has generally taken aim at any defensive measures that would be useful for Taiwan in wartime, whether that be drones or other capabilities, they have also hit out at the Internet slowdown drill. In particular, the KMT sought to tar the Internet drill as some kind of authoritarian measure intended to test capacities to enforce an Internet blackout, claiming that the drill was “False practice, true martial law.”

The DPP framed the slowdown drill as something conducted, too, by other democratic countries in the region such as South Korea and Japan. By contrast, the KMT has pointed to that Internet shutdowns are most commonly carried out by authoritarian countries in order to prevent information from leaking out about atrocities committed during that period.

Indeed, this is not incorrect. The KMT is also not incorrect when it calls on the Lai administration to provide greater clarity about what capacities it specifically hopes to test disruptions to. But it would, of course, be China that would seek to disrupt Taiwan’s Internet in the event of wartime, and such a drill would allow for practicing how to restore capacities–or what needs to be done in order to strengthen resilience. Likewise, the drill would make members of the public more aware of the possibility of disruptions to communication networks in wartime, in that drills are meant to allow the public to imagine what wartime scenarios could look like and to prepare accordingly.

Ironically, the mobile Internet slowdown drill was probably watered down in order to avoid disruption or panicking the public. After all, Wi-Fi Internet was still usable during this time, potentially limiting its ability to test how to restore connectivity in the event of disruptions.

One notes that Taiwan’s civic tech community has long pushed the government on the issue of testing for Internet outages. However, the Taiwanese government was historically reluctant on the matter due to fears that this would ramp up fears about war, affecting Taiwan’s stock market, and potentially leading to electoral blowback against the DPP. In this way, it is surprising that the slowdown drill happened to begin with. But it can be expected that the KMT will attack it nonetheless–further driving home that the party will aim to sabotage any effort by Taiwan to build up capacities that could be useful in wartime.

title: Walfrid Engdahl - Från djupet
content:
Författare

: Walfrid Engdahl

Titel

: Från djupet

Källa

: Allarm 1 juni 1916


 Mitt i hopen av smilande gycklare

 och av ödmjukt krypande fän,

 ibland lismande slippriga hycklare

 och bland böner, suckar och skrän

 hörs ej livslystet klingande sången,

 märks ej viljan, som önskar och kan,

 ej den upprätta spänstiga gången

 av en helgjuten självständig man.


 Ty de fege befolka än tiderna

 och försumpad ungdomen är.

 De ha kvävtss de uppfriskande striderna

 i osund och kvav atmosfär.

 Och det varma och sprudlande blodet,

 vilket livskraftigt sjöd och som brann,

 har försvunnit tillsammans med modet.

 Och det saknas en självständig man.


 Att få bo bland de pösiga låtsarna

 med moralen och kyrkotukt,

 är som gift för de ärliga trotsarna,

 är förpestad gravkammarlukt.

 Deras dådkraft, I fege, förakten,

 ty den uppbäres hänsynslöst sann,

 och I bleknen och darren för makten

 vilken ägs av en självständig man.


 Hur de fylka sig snällt inom båsarna

 med rostiga klavar och band

 och stå lugna bak tillvridna låsarna

 med en lam och orkeslös hand.

 Se, de pröva ej styrkan mot banden

 för att söka om bräckas de kan.

 Ej en skråma får synas på handen

 - ej ett spår av en självständig man.


 Gå med plikter mot möglade gudarna

 och för kungar och fosterland.

 och att dyrka de glänsande skrudarna,

 följa vinken från härskarens hand.

 Att sig själv ge i våldet hos andra,

 gå på knä tills medaljden man vann;

 men ej våga förtryckarna klandra

 som upprorisk och självständig man.


 Men en gång skall de komma dock vindarna

 med sitt domssorl i våldsam fart.

 Det skall rassla och skaka i lindarna.

 Det skall ränsas och brännas snart.

 När allt ruttet blev nergräft i jorden,

 då vi frihet och målet upphann.

 Då den härliga stunden är vorden

 för envar att bli självständig man.

title: Comunicado de los Presos Políticos Mapuche del Módulo Comuneros de la Cárcel de Temuco.
content:
A continuación, difundimos el Comunicado de los Presos Políticos Mapuche del Módulo Comuneros de la Cárcel de Temuco respecto a la medida de dispersión aplicada a los lamgen Francisco Painevilo y Luis Tranamil hacia la Cárcel de Angol y al CCP Biobío de Concepción.


«Marri marri pu lonko, pu werken, pu machi , pu weichafe. Saludamos a todos aquellos que acompañan y abrazan la digna lucha de nuestro pueblo nación  mapuche.


Queremos a través de este comunicado, los ppm del módulo de comuneros mapuche de Temuco enviar nuestro apoyo y fortaleza a los peñi Francisco Painevilo y Luis Tranamil quienes en un contexto de arremetida represiva y represalias de acuerdo a la coyuntura política y las determinaciones del ministerio de seguridad pública, con la dirección nacional de gendarmería de chile como ente represor, se les ha aplicado por este gobierno fascista, el ser llevados a diferentes centros  de reclusión en primera instancia, lejos de sus lof y personas afines.


Además queremos enviar nuestro newen y fortaleza a las familias de los peñi que desde muchísimo tiempo también nos han apoyado en diferentes actividades culturales y de fortalecimiento espiritual dentro del contexto carcelario.


Enviamos nuestro newen y saludo fraterno al peñi Carlos Cancino que se encuentra en una compleja situación de salud en el Hospital penal de Santiago.Hacemos un llamado a acompañar a nuestros peñi y sus familias en las diferentes concentraciones y muestras de apoyo concreto, pu peñi que asumen la prisión política con firmeza ante el poder y su represión sistemática. Bien sabemos que las condiciones carcelarias en complejos penitenciario de alta seguridad  en Concepción  dejan de lado los derechos y condiciones diferenciadas como mapuche.Una realidad que golpea a varios pu PPM encerrados en dicho winka malal.


La situación en cuanto a  nuestro peñi Francisco Painevilo a variado puesto que hoy se encuentra en la Cárcel de  Angol.


Exigimos al poder judicial que considere el retorno de nuestros peñi al módulo de prisioneros político de Temuco y/o se hagan oído a las desicion  de nuestros peñi.Las facultades e interés político del gobierno para acallar al movimiento autonomista mapuche y sus diferentes expresiones de lucha se traducen en estas medidas arbitrarias. Entendemos que esta es una práctica habitual de gendarmería que levanta a presos sociales y los dispersa a diferentes canas, y que esto en su forma se asemeja  a  los acontecimientos sucedidos años antes y también involucra a los PPM,  hoy se aplica en el caso de los peñi del lof Rofue cuestión que responde al momento político de extremar las condiciones carcelaria en casos de alta connotación pública.


•No a la política de dispersión contra los PPM.


•Ante la  militarización y la  cárcel  la respuesta es la unidad en el weichan


•No a las Altas condenas racistas


•Retorno de los peñi Painevilo y Tranamil al módulo mapuche de Temuco.»


*Enviado a la radio.

Radio Kurruf

.

Final Days of Comrade H. N. Goshal

According to the Vol. I, No. 7 of CPI’s Periodical named “Communist”, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Burma passed a political resolution on July 30, 1947 to Communist Party of India on the situation facing the Burmese people immediately after the murder of General Aung San and his colleagues. In their political resolution, the CPB stated that imperialist intrigues could only be "decisively defeated with AFPFL-CP unity.

However, due to the Burmese independence in 1948, CPB had to re-determine whether AFPFL government (along with the socialists inside it) was a “comprador bourgeoisie” or “national bourgeoisie”.

The Goshal Thesis (On the Present Political Situation in Burma and Our Task) by Thakin Ba Tin (Comrade Goshal) answered this question before CPB as a party had reached a conclusion. As a result, the Goshal Thesis became a political line formulated by Thakin Ba Tin (Comrade Goshal), a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of Burma (CPB), which ignited the sparks of the Burmese Civil War.

The original manuscript of the thesis was discovered in research archives kept in Hamburg, Germany, and was published in 1989 by the Verbund Stiftung Deutsches Übersee-Institut (Hamburg) in a compilation titled Documents on Communism in Burma.

However, Communist Party of Burma (CPB) has been denying the existence of such a thesis. In the November 1992 issue (No. 11) of the CPB’s official journal, ‘People's Power’, an article titled "Clarification Regarding the So-Called Goshal Thesis"—written by Comrade Po Than Gyaung, the current spokesperson of the Communist Party of Burma, with informational assistance from the chairperson of the time, Thakin Ba Thein Tin—argued the following:

"Because this analysis [the Goshal Thesis] was written without informing the party and in opposition to the party's line, Comrade Ba Tin was severely criticized by the Political Bureau and the Central Committee. Just prior to this, Thakin Thein Pe had already faced disciplinary action for attacking the party through The Nation newspaper. Comrade Ba Tin explained that he did not write the article himself, but that a leader of the Communist Party of India (CPI) wrote it under his name. With that explanation, the matter was laid to rest.

author: Angel Moore
title: Federal minister says conditions on mining, road projects will mitigate damage to environment
content:
Canada’s minister of Environment and Climate Change says the conditions put on two projects approved by the federal government will help alleviate environmental impacts related to fish, birds and the territory.


Julie Dabrusin told media gathered in Halifax on Wednesday for an announcement about money to help municipalities deal with climate change that there were several consultations during the impact assessment phase, including with Indigenous Peoples.


“There are also conditions attached every time that there is a decision through the impact assessment agency and those conditions are specifically to mitigate those impacts, and they are monitored,” she said in response to a question by APTN News about how far the government will go in approving projects that have adverse effects on the environment. “That’s an important part of the equation that also needs to be included. So, with those projects, as with any others, there are conditions that are taken into account when making that balanced assessment.”


The Crawford Nickel Project is likely to destroy or alter approximately 116 hectares of fish habitat, including the watersheds indicated in this map. Graphic: APTN News.


Crawford Nickel Mine


In the past two months, Dabrusin has approved two projects in northern Ontario.


The first was the Crawford Nickel Mine located 42 kilometres north of Timmins. According to the government, it will be the largest mine in Canada when it starts production. The government said it will “produce high-quality, low-carbon nickel essential for batteries and green steel. It will serve as an anchor of Canada’s global leadership in clean industrial materials.”


The mine, the government said, will “attract $5 billion in investment” and create 5,000 jobs for construction of the project and 1,300 for operations.”


In terms of the climate, “the project’s emissions are nearly 90% lower than the global industry average,” the government said.


Canada has signed business contracts with Mattagami, Matachewan, and Flying Post First Nations and Taykwa Tagamou Nation has “partnered with Canada Nickel Company to invest $20 million in the Crawford Nickel Project,” giving the community an 8.4 per cent stake in the project.


On the environmental side, according to the

impact assessment

, the project will have an “adverse” effect on fish, migratory birds and the lands of the First Nations who are signing onto the project.


According to the 38-page impact assessment released by the government, there are a number of conditions attached to the approval of the mine that the company must abide by, including protecting fish from the mine site.


The impact report said approximately 111 species of migratory birds are either confirmed or assumed to be present in the area, according to the assessment.


“Eleven of these are species at risk (including bank swallow, barn swallow, Canada warbler, chimney swift, eastern whip-poor-will, common nighthawk, evening grosbeak, bobolink, olive-sided flycatcher, yellow rail, and eastern meadowlark),” the report states. “Several species of migratory birds, including waterfowl such as geese, have been identified as species of importance to Indigenous communities.”


There are five conditions binding on the company to protect birds that the proponent needs to carrying out the project “in a manner that protects migratory birds and avoids capturing, killing, taking, injuring or harassing migratory birds or destroying, taking or disturbing their eggs, or damaging, destroying, removing or disturbing nests protected.”


In terms of the damage that will be caused to important sites within the project area, the Mattagami First Nation wrote, “Many sites of cultural significance and value will be irreversibly lost from the project, and related knowledge will not be passed down through generations, hindering cultural continuity.”


The government listed six conditions on the company, Canada Nickel, to “develop, prior to construction and in consultation with Indigenous groups, and relevant authorities… an Archeological and Cultural Resources Management Plan,” the approval letter said. “That includes a chance-find protocol for any previously unidentified structures, sites or things of historical, archaeological, paleontological or architectural significance discovered within the Designated Project area.”


All construction is to be stopped if something is discovered.

author: Andrés
title: Denuncia masiva a la destrucción de décadas de inversión en ciencia y tecnolgía
content:
Masivo acto de la comunidad científica en el Obelisco. Denuncian la destrucción de décadas de inversión social exitosa en ciencia y tecnología. El obelisco se convirtió este miércoles en el escenario de una multitudinaria jornada de protesta en defensa de la ciencia, la tecnología y la universidad pública. Trabajadores y trabajadoras del CONICET, organismos científicos, universidades y organizaciones sociales coparon la plaza para repudiar el ajuste y el desmantelamiento del sistema científico nacional.

Por Leandro Rodríguez para ANRed.


Foto: Leandro Rodríguez


El reclamo tiene un punto central: la no renovación de 374 becas posdoctorales del CONICET, que dejó en la calle a cientos de investigadores, en el marco de un proceso que el sector denuncia como un verdadero desguace de la ciencia argentina. Cada investigador que desaparece es la pérdida de décadas de investigación autónoma acumulada en las instituciones públicas y la pérdida de soberanía científica y productiva. Esos despidos son un hito en el vaciamiento y la desfinanciación, y convergen con los despidos recientes en CNEA, y en otros organismos y con el incumplimiento de la ley de financiamiento universitario.


El acto llamó la atención tanto por la masividad como por la energía positiva que lo recorría. Toda una paradoja. Con casi tres años de ajuste brutal sobre los hombros de todo el sistema de ciencia y técnica y con el último zarpazo de casi 400 despidos en Conicet ya concretado a fin de julio pasado, la comunidad volvió a expresar una voz nítida y contundente.


Foto: Leandro Rodríguez


La organización del acto combinó el llamado de la RAICyT con la participación de todas las organizaciones del sector. La RAICyT es la “Red de Autoridades de Institutos de Ciencia y Tecnología de Argentina”, que agrupa a más de 400 directores y autoridades de organismos como el CONICET y universidades nacionales. Los sindicatos de cada institución también movilizaron, tanto las comisiones internas de ATE como de AGD UBA y CONADUH, así como agrupamientos estudiantiles. Y también lo hicieron buena parte de las corrientes políticas en las que participan los trabajadores del sector, desde tendencias peronistas hasta la izquierda. Para completar la escena, las organizaciones de jubilados que marchan todos los miércoles fueron hasta el Obelisco y completaron el poco espacio que quedaba en la plaza de la república sobre la avenida Corrientes.


Parte de la masividad puede explicarse por esa gran amplitud. Así como por un “cambio de clima” social. El llamado a “ponerse la camiseta por la ciencia” y defender la soberanía, enlazaba en una sola mirada la bandera de Malvinas tomada por los jugadores de la selección con el amplio repudio a las leyes de entrega como la “Ley de tierras” la semana pasada, las voces de los y las referentes jóvenes como Emilia, Tini, Lali, Milo J y tantos otros y la marcha atrás del gobierno retirando esas leyes de diputados.


En el acto se leyó un documento que denuncia el recorte presupuestario, la pérdida de puestos de trabajo, el deterioro salarial y el vaciamiento de organismos estratégicos como CONICET, INTI, INTA, CNEA, CONAE, SMN (servicio meteorológico nacional), entre otros. Allí se enfatizó que la soberanía nacional es imposible sin un sistema de ciencia y técnica y universidades públicas nacionales. Los datos al respecto son contundentes: la inversión en ciencia y tecnología en los países que sostienen empresas competitivas en el mercado mundial, es una inversión básicamente estatal. Desde China hasta Israel y EEUU. En ellos se invierte anualmente del 3 al 5% del PBI de cada país. En Argentina este año la inversión llegó a su piso histórico, el 0.14% del PBI, motosierra mediante. En definitiva, la capacidad de una sociedad de metabolizarse con la naturaleza y vivir sanamente en ella es imposible sin el conocimiento de la ciencia básica y sus aplicaciones productivas. Y ello requiere una inversión social a la que los privados no pueden hacer más que aportes privados parciales e insuficientes.[13/8/2026 17:10] Leandro Leandro: La conexión entre la comunidad científica y la sociedad de conjunto es lo que nunca se rompió, aunque sí está sometida a un inmenso desgaste. La “estrellita culona” del Conicet simboliza la vitalidad de esa conexión y ayer brilló más que nunca en el acto del Obelisco. Esa vitalidad se veía también en las sonrisas y abrazos entre quienes participaron.

title: Smart Solar’da enflasyon zammı gasbedilmek isteniyor
content:
İzmir – Aliağa Organize Sanayi Bölgesi’nde bulunan Smart Güneş Teknolojileri AŞ Fabrikasında işçiler enflasyon farkının yatırılmamasına tepki gösteriyor. Smart işçileri, patron temsilcisinin hem Gebze hem Aliağa fabrikasında işçileri toplayarak şirketin mali olarak zorlanmasını gerekçe göstererek sözleşmede kazanılmış olan enflasyon artı puanın verilmeyeceğini söylediğini dile getirdi. Sözleşmede kazanılmış haklarının gasbedilmeye çalışıldığını ifade eden işçiler bu saldırıya karşı herkesin tepkili olduğunu söylüyor.

Geçtiğimiz dönem sendikanın yalnızca enflasyon oranına sözleşme imzaladığını söyleyen bir işçi “Zaten sözleşmede ezdirildik. Enflasyon üzerine dahi çıkamadık. Yan haklarla oranı yüksek göstermeye çalıştılar. Ama gerçeğimiz ortada. Patronun sözleşmede bizi ezdiği yetmemiş gibi şimdi de imzaladığımız sözleşmeyi bile vermek istemiyor. Bizlere açıklama yapan yönetici savaş, hammadde, ekonomi, zorluklar falan bir ton hikaye anlattı. Sanki bunların sorumlusu bizmişiz gibi bir de bizden anlayışlı olmamızı bekliyorlar” dedi.

Şirketin sürekli büyüdüğünü ifade eden işçi “Yeni yatırımlar, anlaşmalar yapıyorlar. Her yerde reklamlarını açıkça da yapıyorlar. Fabrikada yeni bir imalat alanı açılıyor. O bölüme 230 kişi alınacak, elbette onlar da asgari ücretle veya 30 binle başlatılacak. Yeni yatırımlar yaparken gelip de bize durumlar kötü yalanları anlatıyorlar. Durumların kötü olmadığını çok iyi biliyoruz. Durumlar kötü dahi olsa benim sözleşmede kazandığım hakkımı elimden alması doğru değil. Yasal olarak da bunu yapmaya hakları olmadığını biliyoruz” diye konuştu.

Görüştüğümüz bir diğer işçi ise fabrika yönetiminin ücret seviyelerini aşağı çekmeye çalıştığını belirterek, “55-60 bin bandında çalışan işçileri çeşitli baskılarla, yıldırma politikalarıyla bezdirip yollamayı düşünüyorlar. Yerlerine ise asgari ücret veya bir tık üzeri maaşla çalışan işçi alacaklar. Doldurt boşalt yaparak ücretleri aşağı çekmek istiyorlar” ifadelerini kullandı.

TES-İş Sendikasının pasif tutum aldığını söyleyen işçi “Sözleşmede zaten sendika bizi ezdirdi. Şimdi de bizi savunuyorlar gibi duruyorlar fakat işin sonucunda göreceğiz ne kadar sözlerinin arkasında durduklarını. Biz işçiler olarak sendikadan haklarımızın ezdirilmemesi için mücadele etmesini, güç göstermesini istiyoruz. Bizi gelip ikna etmelerini, durumu kabullenmeye çalıştırmalarını değil. Zaten iş kolu davası, sendika değişikliği gündemleri var. Buradaki işçilerin gözü biraz da Gebze’de. Orada bu saldırıya karşı ne yapılacağı Aliağa’nın geleceği için de belirleyici olabilir. Gebze’nin Birleşik Metal İş Sendikası ile greve çıkarak taleplerini kazanmış olması Aliağa için hâlâ bir örnek olarak duruyor. Bugün de içeride herkes biz de Gebze gibi yapalım, greve çıkalım tartışmaları yapıyor” diye konuştu.

Sendikanın tepkilerin ardından işçilere toplu mesaj atarak patronla yapılacak görüşmeye ve gönderilen resmi yazılara dair bilgi verdiğini aktaran işçi “Maaşlar enflasyon zammı işlemeden yattı. Sözleşmede aldığımıza çökmelerine izin vermek istemiyoruz. El koymuş olsalar bile mücadele ederek yasal hakkımızı kullanarak geri almak için mücadele edeceğiz” diyerek sözlerini tamamladı.

Başka bir Smart işçisi ise sürece dair görüşlerini şöyle aktardı: “Geçen sözleşmede yaklaşık enflasyon oranı uygulandı. Farklar gecikmeli olarak ve 3 taksitte ödendi. Şimdi ise enflasyon zammını yapmayacağını söylüyor patron. Bunun yanı sıra yatırım yapmaya, sermayesini büyütmeye devam ediyor. İşçinin ücreti mi şirketi iflas ettirecek? Fabrika kapatmakla, işsiz bırakmakla tehdit ediyorlar bizi. Kâr ederken bizi ortak etmeyen, zarar ettiğini söyleyerek faturayı işçiye kesmekten geri durmuyor. Tes-İş Sendikası ve Gebze Şubesindeki Birleşik Metal İş Sendikası birlik olup işçinin hakkını savunmalıdır.”

Sendika yönetiminin değişmesinin ardından temsilcilerin atanarak fabrikaya gönderildiğini söyleyen bir işçi ise “Önceki yönetim de problemliydi seçim oldu değişti. Şimdiki yönetimi göreceğiz. Temsilcileri biz seçmedik, başka yerlerden atanarak geldiler. Yönetim değiştikten sonra fabrikanın gelip enflasyonu vermeyeceğiz demesi kafamızda soru işaretleri yaratıyor. Şimdi bir şeye itiraz etsek, muhalefet yapsak fabrika yönetimi hemen bizi fişlemeye tehdit etmeye başlıyor. Sendika da karşısında farklı görüş belirteni istemiyor tabii. Bizim haklarımıza sahip çıksınlar, taleplerimizi dikkate alsınlar biz başka bir şey istemiyoruz. Yoksa işten atma tehditleriyle biz de bir yere kadar sabrederiz. Yeni girenlere verilen …

title: Kocaeli'de 15 yaşındaki çocuğa cinsel taciz iddiası davası: Aile Bakanlığı müdahil olacak
content:
Aile ve Sosyal Hizmetler Bakanlığı, Kocaeli’de 15 yaşındaki bir kız çocuğunun cinsel istismara uğradığı iddiasına ilişkin sürece dahil olduklarını belirterek, açılacak davaya müdahil olacaklarını açıkladı.

Bakanlıktan yapılan açıklamada, olayın basına yansımasının ardından Kocaeli İl Müdürlüğü ekiplerinin mağdur çocuk ve ailesiyle görüşme gerçekleştirdiği bildirildi.

Açıklamada, "Bakanlık olarak failin en ağır cezayı alması için açılacak davaya müdahil olacağız" denildi.

Bakanlık, çocuklara yönelik istismarda "sıfır tolerans" ilkesiyle hareket edildiğini belirterek, yargı sürecinin takip edileceğini ve mağdur çocuk ile ailesine desteğin sürdürüleceğini kaydetti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: “Estamos en la calle para defender la soberanía científica”
content:
Trabajadoras y trabajadores científicos de todo el país se movilizaron en una Jornada Federal de Ciencia, Tecnología y Universidad bajo el lema colectivo “ponete la camiseta” por la ciencia, para expresar el apoyo a un sector estratégico para el desarrollo y la soberanía. Ante el Obelisco dialogamos con Giselle Santana del INTI, que declaró que la situación es “dramática” y denunció que las medidas del gobierno “están poniendo en riesgo la salud y la vida de la población por vaciar los organismos de ciencia y técnica que están al servicio, justamente, de cuidar la vida y la seguridad de la población”.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: CIA Involved in Covert Strikes on Ecuadorian Boats, Report Says
content:
The secretive operation is said to be separate from the Trump administration’s boat strike campaign.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

The Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) is reportedly running a secret operation bombing boats off of the coast of Ecuador that’s separate from the Trump administration’s boat strike campaign, raising more questions about the U.S.’s violence in the region.

The agency was seemingly involved in conducting surveillance flights for attacks on three vessels sailing near the Galápagos Islands in January and March, The Washington Post reported on Thursday. The U.S. has not provided any evidence that the vessels were involved in illicit activities, and survivors have said that they were merely fishing and had no relation to the drug trade.

The attacks include one on a fishing vessel known as the Fiorella on January 20, which vanished without a trace, along with the eight Ecuadorian men on board. They are presumed dead by the UN. In the days prior to the disappearance, crew members had reported seeing drones flying around them, as well as a vessel with U.S. markings.

The other 36 survivors of the strikes have said that they were abducted at gunpoint by men after the attacks on the vessels. They say they were handcuffed and hooded, tortured, and taken to El Salvador. They were then returned to Ecuador, all without explanation.

“They treated us like animals,” one survivor of a March 26 flight told Drop Site News.

Thus far, no country has taken responsibility for the attacks. Human rights experts have raised concerns about the attacks and have called for investigations into U.S. involvement, while prior reports have confirmed U.S. involvement. However, the links to the CIA are new, and spark concern over why the U.S. is involved in secretive strikes with no clear purpose.

Ahead of each of the attacks, on January 20 and March 17 and 26, a surveillance plane took off from El Salvador’s airport, Ilopango, and flew southward toward the Galápagos, per the Post. The plane and six crew arrived in El Salvador from Tennessee in November. The surveillance flights were conducted in a manner that suggests CIA involvement, The Washington Post reported.

The plane flies under a U.S. registration number that is not registered with the Federal Aviation Administration, which allows some aircraft to fly unregistered if they are related to the “national defense forces of the United States.” The plane is listed under a company that does not appear to exist; its mailing address is listed at a Virginia UPS store, as The New York Times reported this week.

The attacks appear similar to the strikes in Operation Southern Spear, the administration’s “narco-terrorism” campaign in the region. However, the administration has consistently touted the strikes. Those strikes have killed 221 people so far and have been labelled as “murder” by critics, who say there is no legal basis for the administration’s “narco-terrorist” label.

The U.S. has remained mum about the three strikes on Ecuadorian ships, despite numerous reports pointing to U.S. involvement and mounting pressure to answer for the strikes. Last month, Drop Site News reported that the Ecuadorian prosecutor assigned to investigate the strikes on the vessels was shot and killed in broad daylight in June.
